title: Fix incoming document attachment overview Line No. type
summary: The Line No. field in the Inc. Doc. Attachment Overview table is changed from Integer to BigInteger to match the corresponding field in Incoming Document Attachment after 64-bit migration.
key_points: Field type mismatch resolved between two related tables after 64-bit migration
Line No. field now consistently uses BigInteger (8 bytes) instead of Integer (4 bytes)
Prevents data narrowing when transferring fields between the tables
Overview table is temporary, so no data migration needed
Existing regression test TestFieldDefinitionsMatch validates the fix
quote: Change `Inc. Doc. Attachment Overview."Line No."` from `Integer` to `BigInteger` to match `Incoming Document Attachment."Line No."`
